braid_artin_images — DRIVE braidpath op

• Data kinds: signal × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.braid_artin_images(word, n_strands) (to call the implementation directly, import braidpath; braidpath.braid_artin_images(word, n_strands); from the registry, opsdrive.get("braid_artin_images"))

Usage

Artin representation of a braid: images (freely reduced words) of the generators x₁..xₙ of the free group F_n.

σᵢ: xᵢ ↦ xᵢ xᵢ₊₁ xᵢ⁻¹, xᵢ₊₁ ↦ xᵢ, all others fixed. The image of a word w = σ_{i1} σ_{i2} … is built by substituting from left to right. This representation is faithful (Artin 1925), so all images agree ⇔ same braid. It is an exact test using only free reduction, a second implementation that confirms “equal” independently of Dynnikov coordinates. The image length can grow exponentially with the word length, so it stops at MAX_WORD letters (RuntimeError). ★The limit is not an argument: a cutoff that does not change the answer becomes a “knob with no effect” (2026-10-23). Empty input (word with 0 elements) returns the images of the identity map (reason: the empty word is the identity, and each image is xₖ itself).

Returns: dict images (list of length n; each element is a list of signed integers, where ±k = x_k^(±1)), lengths, identity (whether every image is xₖ itself).
